Fenced storage (basement level, x 350..408 behind the wing): three 8" posts with caps, three rails per side and a low curb, from the rear elevation.

Terrain: grade profiles read from the V-layer grade splines of the left and right elevations ([z, Y] pairs). Left profile = x<=0 side and the rear-left terrace (stops at the retaining wall x=113.8), right profile = x>=408.0 side and the rear walk-out. In between (z>-D) grade is interpolated across x.

Not extracted (no schema slot / ambiguous): stair guard rails, pantry shelves, shower doors, upper cabinets, cased interior openings without a door block (the open-plan first floor has none), the basement Bilco door (text label only, no door block or wall gap in the DXF), the stair S-turn.
Stairwell holes are NOT cut from level.floor; each flight arrives at the floor of the level above, where the app cuts the opening from the stair outline.

Second floor: front wall and gable walls stop at the frieze top (Y=167.23; the app adds the gable siding above them up to the roof); the rear dormer wall stops at its cornice (Y=217.58); interior partitions are stepped in 6" z-bands under the front slope and full height behind the ridge.
Level.floor is the exterior outline only (basement/first include the rear wing).
